Class Bout

java.lang.Object
org.app.entities.Bout
@Entity public class Bout extends Object
The Bout class represents a jousting match between two characters in the system.

This entity is mapped to the "bouts" table in the database using JPA annotations. Each bout represents a competition between two characters: an attacker and a defender.

JPA Annotations

  • Entity: Marks this class as a JPA entity mapped to a database table.
  • Table: Specifies the database table ("bouts") to which this entity is mapped.
  • Id: Defines the primary key of the entity.
  • Column: Customizes the columns of the entity with constraints (e.g., nullable = false).
  • ManyToOne: Defines many-to-one relationships with Character for both the attacker and defender.
  • JoinColumn: Specifies the foreign key relationships to associate the bout with attacking and defending characters.

Relationships

Each bout involves two characters: one attacker and one defender, both of which are represented by Character entities. This creates two many-to-one relationships where a bout has a reference to two distinct characters.

Key Fields:

  • boutKey: The unique identifier for the bout entity.
  • tourney: The name of the tourney in which the bout takes place.
  • attackerPoints: The points scored by the attacking character in the bout.
  • defenderPoints: The points scored by the defending character in the bout.
  • attacker: A reference to the Character who is the attacker in the bout.
  • defender: A reference to the Character who is the defender in the bout.
